Hi, we have just uploaded a hot patch fixing the problem that some Players are experiencing with the boxes of the chapter 3 and 6.

If you are still having this issue after the update please send your saved game to support@fourattic.com .

Thanks for your patiente!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
We are more than excited to announce Crossing Souls' release date... Are you ready? 

[b]Turn up the volume, click PLAY and enjoy![/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uXQ0chPzJ_k

[b]Yes! Mark this day in your calendar: February 13, 2018.[/b]

We couldn't be prouder of the game, seriously. We have reached and surpassed all our previous expectations. It’s been a long journey, full of joys and sorrows, and now we can say aloud that the game is ready and was worth any second of development spent on it. This wouldn’t be possible without all your support, seriously. We hope your excitement about this release to be as deep as ours.

Please, share THAT trailer on your social networks and spread the word! We want your friends to join our adventure as well!

[b][u]PLAYSTATION EXPERIENCE 2017[/u][/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26687446/407b036b3c2b8e2e9b806ccd5cecf53ddacbeac6.png[/img]

We are going to be at [url=https://www.playstation.com/en-us/campaigns/2017/playstation-experience/] PlayStation Experience 2017!	[/url] [b]We will be there from December 9 to 10, with our game playable[/b] waiting for you. Don’t hesitate and come by to say hello. We will be more than happy to talk with you guys.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26687446/8f0ea4bae6c768d23d9eed729881eebafd6bcf96.png[/img]

That’s all! The next months are gonna be exciting!  ːsteamhappyː
